description: Consumer dispute letter + deadlines — Draft a firm dispute letter for a credit-card billing error (Fair Credit Billing Act), credit-report error (FCRA), debt-collection validation (FDCPA) or merchant refund, with the statutory timeline, a computed send-by deadline and days left from date (statement or notice date), placeholders to fill, and checks that the amount, law and remedy are stated. Optional: type (billing|credit-report|debt-validation|merchant, default billing), date YYYY-MM-DD, amount, recipient, remedy. Not legal advice. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

details.description: e.g. I was charged $49.99 twice by Acme Streaming on my Nov 3 statement. Please remove the duplicate charge.

name: ai_dispute_letter
